part: live spike (local Docker), ADR-0001 protocol, option C prototype
previous: reports/conformance/M4-live.json (option A: NO-GO, criteria 2 and 3 failed)
commit_note: Stand, adapter, verifier, scripts and evidence are in the same commit as this report. A commit cannot contain its own SHA.
post_run_code_changes: ruff format only (whitespace/line wrapping) on adapter.py, gxg_verify.py, attacks_c.py; redact_jws.py applied to evidence after the run
author: Claude Code (local executor, M4 live part)

environment.echo_runtime: v1.1.1 image Python (PyJWT 2.15.1, cryptography 50.0.2), code echo/echo_server.py + echo/gxg_verify.py

contextforge_config.IDENTITY_PROPAGATION_ENABLED: false (option A off, C stands alone)

environment.topology: same as option A run: 2 teams x 2 agents, per team a plain and an aliased echo gateway, one virtual server with both tools

mechanism.adapter: spikes/m4-live/adapter/adapter.py, ContextForge tool_pre_invoke plugin, mode enforce, priority 1000
mechanism.inputs: global_context.user_context (user_id, teams), global_context.metadata['gateway'] (url, team_id), payload.args, payload.name; all set by ContextForge after authentication, not by the agent
mechanism.output: header X-GXG-Identity: compact JWS, alg EdDSA (Ed25519), typ gxg-id+jwt, kid gxg-adapter-1

claims.aud: upstream gateway URL as registered in ContextForge
claims.tenant_id: team_id of the gateway; issued only if the caller token teams == [gateway team]
claims.ahs: sha256 of canonical JSON arguments (sort_keys, separators (',',':'), UTF-8)

mechanism.fail_closed_in_adapter: no user / no team-owned gateway / team mismatch -> PluginViolation, request not sent; caller-supplied X-GXG-Identity removed before signing
mechanism.keys: private key only mounted into ContextForge (secrets/adapter_ed25519.pem, gitignored); connector has only the public key
mechanism.verifier: spikes/m4-live/echo/gxg_verify.py: exactly one header; alg/typ/kid; signature; iss; aud == own URL; required claims; exp-iat <= 60; leeway 5 s; iat not in future; ahs == hash(received arguments); jti not seen (in-memory until exp). On reject the echo returns JSON-RPC -32001 unauthenticated and does not execute

criteria.text: Agent cannot influence tenant_id and principal via arguments, headers or _meta
evidence: results-c-v1.1.1.json and results-c-upgraded.json: 10/10 F-* cases accepted with sub=t-alpha-a1, tenant=t-alpha team, exactly one X-GXG-Identity value at the upstream
F-own-jws-rpc/-vs: agent sends a real, captured X-GXG-Identity of t-beta-a1 -> upstream sees only the adapter's token for t-alpha-a1
F-garbage-jws-*: garbage X-GXG-Identity from the agent -> dropped
F-fwd-headers-*: X-Forwarded-User-* from the agent -> not forwarded (forwarded_user_headers_seen empty)
F-meta-*: _meta.user and _meta.gxg_identity (a real JWS) from the agent reach the upstream as data inside _meta, the verifier ignores _meta
F-args-*: tenant_id/agent_id/sub in arguments reach the upstream as data and are covered by ahs; identity unchanged

criteria.text: A request that bypasses ContextForge does not get an identity
evidence: B-alg-none (unsigned token with real claims) -> rejected, bad header
B-tenant-swap (captured token, tenant_id changed to t-beta, signature kept) -> InvalidSignatureError
B-other-aud (captured token sent to the t-beta connector URL) -> InvalidAudienceError
B-other-args (captured token, different arguments) -> arguments hash mismatch
criteria.caveat: Not tested: an attacker who captures a token in flight before it reaches the connector and delivers the same arguments first (race). Within <= 60 s that token is usable exactly once. Mitigation is TLS + network isolation of connectors (SEC-04), not checked here.

criteria.text: Replay of intercepted identity after > 60 s is rejected
evidence: R-replay-fast: same token and same arguments a few seconds later -> replayed jti
R-replay-66s: same token and arguments after 66 s -> ExpiredSignatureError
R-fresh-after: a new legitimate call gets a new jti (jti_differs_from_captured = true)
criteria.caveat: jti cache is in-memory per connector process: a restarted or second replica would accept a token replayed within its 60 s window. Production needs a shared cache (or per-replica aud).

criteria.text: Identity works on all paths: direct tools, virtual servers, aliases
evidence: 16/16 accepted with the caller's sub and tenant on v1.1.1 fresh, v1.1.0 fresh, and after upgrade: 4 agents x {direct tool /rpc, alias /rpc, virtual server + plain tool, virtual server + aliased tool}
criteria.caveat: Same as option A: global /mcp tools/call with a team-scoped API token is refused by ContextForge RBAC ('Access denied') before plugins run, so not observed. resources/read, prompts/get, direct_proxy mode, A2A not covered by the adapter (only tool_pre_invoke).

criteria.scope: one minor upgrade v1.1.0 -> v1.1.1 in place, same PostgreSQL data, same adapter code and keys
evidence: results-c-upgraded.json: after replacing the ContextForge container with v1.1.1 (__version__ = 1.1.1, DB kept) all P/F/B/R cases repeat with the same verdicts
criteria.caveat: Only one upgrade step. The adapter depends on cpex internals (HttpHeaderPayload, GATEWAY_METADATA, ToolPreInvokePayload.headers, which v1.1.1 marks deprecated in favour of extensions.http.headers). Must be re-run on every pinned upgrade; the headers field removal is a known future break.

fail_closed.adapter_broken_default_flag: PLUGINS_FAIL_ON_PLUGIN_ERROR unset/false (ContextForge default): gateway STARTS with 0 plugins ('Skipping plugin GxgIdentityAdapter because fail_on_plugin_error is disabled'); every call reaches the connector without identity and is rejected (8/8 missing identity, results-c-broken-default.json)
fail_closed.adapter_broken_flag_true: PLUGINS_FAIL_ON_PLUGIN_ERROR=true: gateway does not start (exit 1, 'Plugin initialization failed: GxgIdentityAdapter')
fail_closed.plugin_yaml_setting_ignored: plugin_settings.fail_on_plugin_error in the YAML did not take effect on v1.1.1; only the env var did (observed while building the stand)
fail_closed.adapter_runtime_error: observed during development, not in committed evidence: an exception inside the adapter returned 'Plugin Error' to the agent and the call was not sent upstream

tenant_isolation_informational: X-rpc-beta-tool: Tool not found, not delivered

preliminary_decision.option_C: GO (prototype): all 5 criteria passed on the stand, with the caveats above
remaining_before_accepting: shared jti cache across connector replicas
cover resources/read and prompts/get (resource_pre_fetch / prompt hooks) or forbid them for connectors
move to extensions.http.headers before ToolPreInvokePayload.headers is removed
key rotation (kid set on the connector side), key storage outside the ContextForge container filesystem
principal: email is mutable; ContextForge does not expose the token sub (UUID) in UserContext.user_id - decide principal format (SEC-01)
implement IdentityVerifier in gxg-connector-kit from gxg_verify.py, with tests

not_run_or_not_checked: upgrade across more than one minor version; downgrade
multi-worker ContextForge / Redis; several connector replicas
TLS between ContextForge and connector, network isolation
global /mcp tools/call (RBAC denies team-scoped API tokens)
resources, prompts, A2A, direct_proxy gateway mode
duplicate X-GXG-Identity headers on the wire (verifier rejects them, but urllib cannot send two headers; not exercised live)
performance cost of signing per call
secrets_scan: evidence/* grepped for every .env value and 'PRIVATE KEY': no matches. JWS values in evidence replaced by <jws sha256=...>; raw tokens only in evidence/raw/ (gitignored)
